request: Drop the headerName option from bearer-auth and always read Authorization, so every service uses the same credential header.

source.request: Drop the headerName option from bearer-auth and always read Authorization, so every service uses the same credential header.
source.settled: Bearer authentication supports custom credential headers through the headerName option.
source.why: Hardwiring Authorization would remove support for custom credential headers.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
